name: ai.bluebed.property/new-launches
title: Singapore new launches
description: Reviewed Singapore new-launch floor plans, area details and buyer rules. Trial.

tools.name: list_launches
tools.description: Lists the new launches this service covers: name, property type (condo or ec, an executive condominium), district, street, number of units, stage, launch date, whether it is sold out, and whether floor plans and area details are available. It covers a selection of launches during the trial. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.

tools.name: search_floor_plans
tools.description: Searches floor plans across the reviewed launches, a selection during the trial. Filter by property type (condo or ec), bedrooms, size in square feet, postal district, launch stage, features such as a kitchen window, and a maximum budget in Singapore dollars. Plans in matches meet every constraint you supplied; plans in close miss exactly one, or could not be checked on one, as shown in each plan's fit (met, missed or unknown). The close list holds at most 20 plans, those with the fewest unknowns first; close_total says how many came close and close_truncated whether some were left out, so narrow the filters to see them. Cull both lists against what your user actually wants. Each result gives the plan, its stacks (stacks_note explains an asterisk), a link to the plan image, and a price with its kind and date. When nothing matches or comes close, the reply names which filters excluded the plans. Prices are guidance from developer price lists: indicative before launch, reset on booking day, and subject to promotions afterwards. Treat them as a starting point and confirm with the agent. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.

property_types.description: condo or ec. Leave out to include both.

include_sold_out.description: Include sold-out launches. Not scored as a constraint.

tools.name: get_launch
tools.description: Returns one launch by slug: its property type (condo or ec, which adds a notice on executive condominiums), its reviewed facts with source and page, the price statement with its kind and date, and the gaps the material leaves open. Prices are guidance from developer price lists: indicative before launch, reset on booking day, and subject to promotions afterwards. Treat them as a starting point and confirm with the agent. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.

slug.description: The launch slug, as returned by list_launches

tools.name: get_unit_type
tools.description: Returns one unit type of a launch by slug and type name: size, bathrooms, powder rooms and WCs, stacks (stacks_note explains an asterisk), the plan image, the answers read from the plan, and the questions the plan does not settle. Prices are guidance from developer price lists: indicative before launch, reset on booking day, and subject to promotions afterwards. Treat them as a starting point and confirm with the agent. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.

slug.description: The launch slug, as returned by list_launches

type.description: The unit type name, as returned by search_floor_plans or get_launch

tools.name: get_area
tools.description: Returns the reviewed area details of a launch by slug: address, tenure, nearby amenities with straight-line distances, schools within two kilometres, and food places the agent has visited himself. Where the area has been measured, it also returns the three nearest MRT or LRT stations with straight-line and walking distances, stop counts to six key stations, and primary school bands per block, each labelled with its source and date. Schools are listed for orientation only and the reply says where to verify them. Available for launches that show area details in list_launches, even when floor plans are not yet available. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.

slug.description: The launch slug, as returned by list_launches

tools.name: rules_for_buyer
tools.description: Quotes the Singapore property rules that apply to a buyer, exactly as published, with the authority, source link, effective date and the date each was last checked: additional buyer's stamp duty, buyer's stamp duty, financing limits and seller's stamp duty. It quotes and does not work out any duty or rate; read the figure from the quote. Seller's stamp duty depends on the purchase date, so supply purchase_date to get the right regime. Supply slug for an executive condominium launch to add the EC rules that apply to its site. A rule that is being re-checked is named without its quote. This is general information and not advice on a particular purchase; confirm with the agent.

profile.description: The buyer's status: sc (Singapore Citizen), spr (Singapore Permanent Resident), foreigner or entity

properties_owned.description: Residential properties the buyer already owns: 0, 1 or 2 (2 means two or more)

purchase_date.description: Date the property was or will be bought, as YYYY-MM-DD. Chooses the seller's stamp duty regime.

slug.description: A launch slug. For an executive condominium, the reply adds the EC rules for that site.
